atomic_red_team_reference.atomic_name: Modify Registry tests using reg.exe and cleanup

candidate_wazuh_rule.description: Value added to registry key has Base64-like pattern

executed_behaviors: The launcher creates a Base64 representation of the current RUN identifier.
reg.exe adds the string to a run-specific HKCU registry key.
A second reg.exe process queries the run-specific value.
The launcher measures the stored value and records a SHA256 hash.
expected_artifacts: Registry add stdout and stderr files
Registry query stdout and stderr files
explicit_non_actions: The stored Base64 text is not decoded or executed.
No autorun, policy, service, security-control or system-wide registry key is modified.
No network, credential, account or persistence operation is performed.

negative_behavior_catalog.behavior: The stored Base64 text is not decoded or executed.
No autorun or other persistence entry is created or modified.
No system policy or system-wide registry setting is modified.
No service or security-control setting is modified.
No credential or account operation is performed.

causal_boundaries: The first reg.exe process writes the value; the second reg.exe process only queries it.
Base64-like data storage is not evidence that the data was executed.
The registry Event ID 13 and reg.exe process command line are separate corroborating evidence.
preferred_anchor: A current-RUN wazuh-alerts-* event for rule 92041 with rule.id, rule.level and rule.description present.
correlation_requirements: The alert command line must include the current RUN registry path.
The Event ID 13 targetObject must identify the current RUN key and value.
known_telemetry_gaps: Registry value content visibility depends on Sysmon configuration and Wazuh field forwarding.
The accepted formal run has no run-specific Sysmon Event ID 13 for HKCU\Software\WazuhLab\<RUN_ID>\Data; nearby Event ID 13 records are unrelated BAM or system activity.

accepted_runtime_telemetry_override.missing_evidence: Run-specific Sysmon Event ID 13 RegistryValueSet telemetry
scoring_effect: Do not include the unavailable run-specific Event ID 13 in any tested agent's evidence-recall denominator.
Do not deduct timeline or evidence-completeness points merely because a report does not mention that unavailable event.
Do not use the runtime manifest to supplement evidence that was not visible to the tested agent.
A report that claims it found the run-specific Event ID 13 is factually inaccurate.
accepted_runtime_telemetry_override.uniform_application: Apply the same boundary to simple_agent, plus_agent and attack_attribution_agent across all three repetitions.
